parts:
Fraenzi and Tobias's book is due out late April:

http://www.amazon.com/Bayesian-Analysis-Ecology-Linear-Models/dp/0128013702

Michael and I sent them comments on the Stan parts. I
didn't realize this'd be anything other than the notes for
their tutorials. It'll look good under "broader impacts"
for NSF.

I'd have thought anyone would use JAGS now instead of BUGS,
but apparently not.

- Bob
